title: Advent Door Calendar
d: Twenty-four foil-gold doors with real 3D hinges on a green board with falling snow: unlocked doors swing open one by one to reveal an emoji alcove, and later doors stay red and locked.

title: Agenda Schedule Accordion
d: A conference agenda accordion with a running clock: the session that is on now gets a blue ring, LIVE badge and progress line, and goes live and opens as the hour reaches it.

title: Agent Approval Gate
d: A human-in-the-loop approval card where an agent asks permission with a risk badge, a diff preview and a countdown ring, then executes with a progress overlay once approved.

title: Agent Browser Cursor
d: An AI agent cursor driving a flight search page: it glides to each field, types, clicks Search so fares slide in, and every step is written to an action log beside the browser.

title: Agent Plan Checklist
d: An AI agent working through a six-step plan: the active step spins and names its tool, a terminal streams log lines, a failing test turns a step amber before a retry passes, and counters climb.

title: Agent Token Budget
d: A context-window meter for an AI agent run: stacked segments grow as it works with a rising dollar cost and throughput chart, then compact into a striped summary block at the 90 percent line.

title: AI Command Palette
d: A palette that understands plain English: a sentence is typed, a gradient line flows while skeletons shimmer, then a three-step plan runs with spinners and ticks while a live preview really changes.

title: ASCII Donut Spinner
d: The classic rotating ASCII torus rendered live in a green phosphor terminal, with a side panel showing both rotation angles, the luminance ramp and the point count.

title: ASCII Flow Field
d: A full-card field of characters driven by overlapping sine waves, density mapped to a dot-to-at ramp and a blue-to-magenta hue, with a ghost cursor that pushes glyphs away and brightens them.

title: ASCII Image Converter
d: A generated sunset scene shown next to its live ASCII conversion, with a scan line and ramp chips that switch between classic punctuation, shade blocks, dots and binary.

title: ASCII Waveform Player
d: A retro amber music player whose equaliser is drawn entirely with block characters, plus a text progress bar, track metadata and chunky keycap controls.

title: Availability Matrix Calendar
d: A group scheduling grid where participants join one by one, every slot recolours by how many people are free, and the single slot that works for everyone gets an outline, pulse and Best time tag.

title: Branching Reply Chat
d: A chat reply with regenerate branches: a 2 of 2 counter with arrows, a shimmering skeleton while a new tagline generates, sideways slides between branches and tone chips like Punchier.

title: Calc Convert Palette
d: A palette that doubles as calculator and converter: a query is typed, the result number rolls up, source and working fade in, Copy result presses itself and the query joins a recent list.

title: Calendar Clock Picker
d: A day strip and an analogue clock work together: a day pill lifts and turns green, then the hour and minute hands swing to the new time with a springy overshoot while the digital readout, AM and PM switch and summary update.

title: Callback Ring Contact
d: A call-me-back widget: a phone number is typed, Call me presses, the green phone shakes inside expanding ripple rings, then it flips to a blue Connected state with a ticking timer and a live voice waveform.

title: Case Study Metric Clients
d: Three customer result cards form a horizontal accordion: the active card swells, its headline metric counts up, a pull quote and speaker fade in and a sparkline sits behind.

title: Chat File Drop Chat
d: A file is dragged into a chat: a dashed Drop to attach zone fades in, the file lands as an outgoing bubble whose progress bar fills to Uploaded, and the assistant types and replies with the clauses it found.

title: Check Animation Gallery
d: Six checkboxes each with their own animation, a drawn stroke, ripple flood, 3D flip, squash and stretch, droplet with spray and a random pixel fill, toggling in a staggered wave.

title: Circular Ring Carousel
d: Eight scene cards on a true 3D cylinder that turns steadily with the front card brightest and the rest dimming by angle, with a floor glow and a label naming the front card; drag to spin with inertia.

title: Citation Answer Chat
d: A sourced AI answer where numbered citation chips pop in turn, the sentence each supports glows blue and the matching source card lifts out of the row with a relevance meter.

title: Client Activity Feed
d: A live customer sign-up feed where each new team drops in at the top with a green glow, the list slides down, the counter ticks up and a sparkline of signups scrolls.

title: Client Count Timeline
d: Eight years of customer growth rebuild from the left: each year stacks coloured blocks that pop in, a count and milestone tag appear and the big number rolls up with a ghost year counter.

title: Commit Graph Changelog
d: A repository history drawn from the oldest commit upward: branch lines trace in colour, feature and hotfix branches curve away from main and merge back, commit dots pop and messages slide in with release tags lit green.

title: Consent Receipt
d: Preferences become a paper trail: after Save my choices, a till-roll receipt feeds from a dark slot with a torn edge, its lines print one by one with ID, timestamp, allowed or denied marks and a barcode, then tears away.

title: Cookie Jar Consent
d: A glass cookie jar fills as consent is given: essential cookies sit at the bottom, enabling a category drops its cookies in with a bounce, Accept all fills the jar and Only essentials empties it.

title: Cookie Scan Report
d: A cookie scanner audits a site: a cyan scan line sweeps down a list as cookie rows slide in with vendor, lifetime and a category chip, counters and a stacked bar grow, and a privacy risk rating resolves at the end.

title: Copy Details Contact
d: Three contact rows each with a copy button: a row outlines and nudges as if hovered, the copy icon spins into a tick on a green button, the row turns mint and a Copied tooltip pops, with a response-rate ring below.

title: Cost Anomaly Alert
d: A cloud-spend alert where a live line crosses a dashed threshold, turning rose with a pulsing ring, a 3.4x NORMAL badge, a glowing card and action buttons that rise in.

title: CSAT Rating Chat
d: A post-chat satisfaction card where a highlight springs between five emoji faces, the label and accent change from red to green and a follow-up opens: a typed comment for a low score or reason chips for a high one.

title: Day Timeline Calendar
d: A single-day calendar with a creeping red now line where a cursor drags to create an event: a dashed ghost block stretches with live times, the title types itself and the block locks in with a toast.

title: Diff Only Comparison Table
d: A plan comparison table with a gliding column highlight and a Differences only switch that squeezes away every identical row, leaving only what distinguishes the plans.

title: Diff Release Notes Changelog
d: A release-notes card where Added, Improved and Fixed counts tick up, notes slide in with colour-coded tags and a before and after mock of the redesigned dialog is revealed by a sweeping white divider.

title: Docs Callout Alerts
d: Four documentation callouts, Note, Tip, Warning and Danger, each with its own icon motion, a bar that draws down the left edge, and dismissal that collapses and slides the row away.

title: Dunning Retry Billing
d: A failed-payment recovery card: a declined Visa above a four-step retry timeline and a draining grace bar, then the card flips in 3D to a new Mastercard, the retry spins and succeeds and everything turns green.

title: Emoji Burst Cursor
d: A pointing-hand cursor taps around a purple stage and each tap fires emoji up and outward in a fan with random size and spin, arcing under gravity and fading, with a reaction counter tallying them all.

title: Feature Spotlight Banner
d: A purple release banner whose tilted app mock toggles between light and dark on a loop: a cursor glides to the switch, the knob springs and the whole window recolours.

title: Film Strip Border
d: A 35mm film strip with scrolling sprocket holes slides past an amber gate; frames brighten and swell near the centre, the frame counter and timecode update and a REC lamp blinks.

title: Flight Dates Picker
d: A two-month flight date picker with each day's fare under the date, cheap days in green and peak days in orange; a start springs in, a pale band follows a hover to the return date and the summary totals nights and price.

title: FLIP Filter Blog Grid
d: A journal grid whose filter chips shrink away non-matching posts, glide the remaining cards to new positions with a FLIP spring and pop returning cards back in, with a count that updates.

title: Gooey Blob Cursor
d: Nine black circles chase the cursor with their own spring lag and a goo filter fuses them into one stretchy liquid blob with a thinning tail, over a coral field and a difference-blended headline.

title: HUD Chamfer Border
d: Sci-fi interface panels with chamfered corners, a glowing light circling each border, corner brackets and a pulsing LOW tag, plus a radar sweep and segment bars that drift with their readouts.

title: Incident Status Banner
d: A service-incident alert that moves through Investigating, Identified, Monitoring and Resolved: the banner recolours with a pulsing icon, a timeline update drops in and service dots shift from failing to healthy.

title: Invoice History Download
d: An invoice table where each download button fills a progress ring then becomes a green tick while a PDF chip drops into a dark tray whose button comes alive with a running count.

title: Ledger Row Accordion
d: A transaction list where each row opens into a paper receipt with a torn zigzag edge whose dotted line items print one after another down to a ruled total.

title: Logo Grid Quote Morph
d: Twelve client wordmarks in a grid with one active: a coloured ring springs between logos while the testimonial card recolours, fades its quote and swaps the headline metric.

title: Magazine Cover Blog
d: A magazine front page where the cover story slowly zooms, a red progress line runs along the highlighted story and a curtain wipes in the next story with its headline revealing word by word.

title: Maintenance Countdown Announcement
d: A scheduled-maintenance notice with ticking flip digits, a sliding warning-stripe bar and a three-phase plan that advances from Read-only to Maintenance to Back online with a colour change.

title: Monitor Scroll Mockup
d: A desktop monitor shows a long marketing page that scrolls with a real easing curve between stops (hero, features, testimonial, stats, call to action) while a pointer glides and a glass reflection sweeps the screen.

title: Month Agenda Sync Calendar
d: A month grid and day agenda that stay in sync: a gradient selection tile glides between dates while the previous day's events lift away and the new day's events slide up in sequence.

title: Multi-Select Chip Checkbox
d: Interest chips act as checkboxes: each round badge spins from a plus to a tick as the chip fills with its own colour, while a dark action bar springs up with growing emoji avatars and a live count.

title: New Hire Announcement
d: A warm welcome card with a spinning gradient ring around an illustrated portrait, a waving hand and reaction buttons whose counts tick up while emoji float away.

title: Office Hours Contact
d: A studio's opening hours come alive: a clock runs across the day, a marker slides along a 24-hour bar, the card is grey and sleepy before nine, then flips to a pulsing green online state and the team lights up one by one.

title: Order Status Bot Chat
d: A support bot answers Where is my order? with a live order card: a progress line draws through four steps, the ETA counts down and milestone messages are posted in the chat.

title: Origami Fold Accordion
d: A shipping and care accordion whose panels unfold like paper: three leaves hinge down from the top edge one after another with a shaded crease that lightens as they flatten.

title: Parallax Slide Carousel
d: Four full-bleed slides with true parallax: the landscape drifts at half speed, a giant outlined numeral at another rate and the headline faster than the slide, with spring-eased glides between slides.

title: Phone Orbit Mockup
d: A phone floats in 3D swinging through plus and minus 22 degrees while its screen cross-fades between steps, spending and sleep cards, with three glass feature chips bobbing around it and each one popping when its screen appears.

title: Postage Stamp Border
d: Three postage stamps with real scalloped perforated edges and printed scenes sit on an air-mail envelope while a circular postmark with wavy cancel lines slams down on each in turn.

title: Promo Code Takeover
d: A loud lime sale banner with a scrolling offer marquee, huge outlined headline, flipping countdown digits and a ticket-style code chip whose Copy button turns into a green Copied tick.

title: Proration Preview Billing
d: A plan-change preview that recomputes live: switch plan or seats and see the credit for unused time, the prorated charge, tax and a rolling due-today total, with a billing-cycle bar that re-balances.

title: Quick Reply Flow Chat
d: A shopping assistant chat that plays itself: typing dots precede each bot message, quick-reply chips pop in and the chosen one becomes the user bubble, then a product carousel appears and an Add button turns green.

title: Quick Switcher Palette
d: A fuzzy file switcher where typed letters filter the list, matched letters turn indigo, a highlight glides to the top result and a preview pane shows the file's icon and syntax-coloured code.

title: Radar Skills Chart
d: Two glowing radar polygons, earlier and latest, morph between three teams' datasets, with legend averages and a biggest-mover readout computed from the live shapes.

title: Regional Consent Banner
d: One consent banner that adapts to the visitor's region: for EU, California, Brazil and Japan it fades, shows Detecting your region, then re-renders with that law's tag, wording, accent colour and button set.

title: Release Radar Changelog
d: A radar of Later, Next and Now rings where upcoming features glide inward with a pulse ring as they get closer to shipping, while a grouped list re-sorts and the moved item flashes.

title: Ribbon Trail Cursor
d: A glowing head follows the pointer on a spring and drags a 44-segment ribbon behind it that is thick and bright near the head and thin and transparent at the end, hue cycling and thickening with speed.

title: Ruler Scrub Date Picker
d: A ruler-style date scrubber: a fixed playhead over a gliding strip of day ticks with taller labelled Mondays and month starts, while the huge day number, weekday, month and relative phrase update live.

title: Sankey Flow Chart
d: A three-column Sankey of 10,000 sessions flowing from traffic sources through pages to outcomes, every ribbon carrying moving dashes while one source at a time is spotlit with its sessions and conversion rate.

title: Scroll to Accept Terms
d: A terms dialog whose checkbox is locked until you reach the end: a progress ring and edge bar fill with scroll, the lock opens with a wobble, the box ticks, Continue lights up and a success toast rises.

title: Semver Ladder Changelog
d: A release ladder whose node shape shows the semver level, a gold diamond for major, violet circle for minor and teal dot for patch; new versions drop in with a shockwave ring and push the rest down.

title: Series Story Progress Blog
d: A multi-part article series read like stories: a segmented bar fills for the current part, then the giant numeral and headline slide out, the next slide in, and the colours cross-fade.

title: Session Timeout Alert
d: A sign-out warning dialog over a dimmed app: the ring drains and turns green, amber, red with a seconds countdown, and Stay signed in presses itself, springs the modal away and raises a success toast.

title: Shake Attention Modal
d: An unsaved-changes dialog that protects the user: clicking the dim backdrop shakes the card with a red ring and glow and unfolds a warning, then Save draft and leave closes it and a green toast confirms.

title: Slide-Over Panel Modal
d: A slide-over details drawer on an orders table: the page dims and blurs as the panel slides in, a cursor moves the tab underline between Details, Activity and Files with staggered content, then closes the panel.

title: Smart TV Mockup
d: A smart-TV home screen driven by a tiny on-screen remote: a pressed arrow lights, the white focus ring and enlarged poster step along the row, the backdrop cross-fades and the hero details swap.

title: Spec Duel Comparison
d: Two phones float head to head under a pulsing VS badge: each spec row's pair of glowing bars grows outward from the centre while numbers count, a star marks each round's winner and win tallies update.

title: Spec Sheet Accordion
d: A technical spec accordion for a pair of headphones where each open panel charges tick-mark gauges and counts every figure up from zero.

title: Spend Forecast Billing
d: A month-end spend forecast with a solid actual line, a dotted projection inside a confidence band, a dashed budget rule, an overage area and scenario chips that bend the forecast.

title: Spotlight Lens Cursor
d: A dark screen shows only a blurred ghost of the headline until a glowing lens with a magnifier handle glides over it; inside the lens the headline turns to a sunset gradient and a hidden paragraph becomes readable.

title: Stacked Modal Flow
d: Three modals stack in depth instead of replacing each other: the invite step recedes behind the role picker with a scale-down, lift and dimming, then both recede behind a success modal, and Done dismisses the stack.

title: Stepper Form Contact
d: A three-step contact form that fills itself: a topic tile is chosen, the panel slides sideways to details where name, email and message are typed, a review step lists them and a green check springs in after Send.

title: Streaming Markdown Chat
d: An assistant reply that streams like a real model: a heading, paragraph with bold, a syntax-coloured code block whose Copy button flips to Copied, a bullet list and a table, each typed with a caret.

title: Stroke Draw Border Cards
d: Cards whose borders are single SVG paths that draw themselves: one traces the outline in a pass, one sends two strokes that meet on the far side, and one runs a string of dashes forever.

title: Success Celebration Modal
d: A payment-complete dialog that celebrates: the card springs up, a green ring draws, the check strokes in with a pulse, confetti fans out, the amount counts up and receipt lines slide in.

title: Tablet Sketch Mockup
d: A tablet running a sketch app draws a lighthouse stroke by stroke; the stylus tip rides the exact end of each line, the palette highlights the ink in use and the drawing is wiped and redrawn.

title: Thumbnail Sync Carousel
d: A photo carousel whose main image cross-fades with a Ken Burns zoom while its caption slides up and a thumbnail strip centres the active frame, which rises with an indigo ring and a progress line.

title: ToC Scrollspy Article
d: A long-read article that scrolls itself while a contents list follows: an orange marker slides and resizes to the current heading, and a ring and minutes-left readout track progress.

title: Track Changes Comparison
d: A document review with tracked edits: Changes view shows red strikethrough deletions and green additions, the switch glides to Original and Suggested so edits collapse, and Accept all resolves each edit.

title: Treemap Morph Chart
d: A spend treemap where switching quarter re-runs a squarified layout and every tile glides and resizes to its new place while figures, shares and the rolling total update.

title: Tri-State Tree Checkbox
d: A permissions tree with true tri-state parents: checked when all children are on, a dash when only some are, empty when none, with counts, a root box and a progress summary.

title: Vertical Reel Carousel
d: A phone plays short vertical reels: a segmented progress bar fills, a double-tap heart bursts and the like counter ticks up, then the stack glides to the next reel.

title: Voice Conversation Orb
d: A voice assistant screen where a blobby orb swells with the voice level and recolours through listening, thinking and speaking while captions light up word by word and a call timer ticks.

title: Waterfall Bridge Chart
d: An ARR bridge from opening to closing revenue: the start bar rises, green bars grow up from the running total, red bars drop down, dashed connectors link levels and values count up with net retention and growth.

title: Which-Key Chord Palette
d: A which-key chord palette: the leader key slides up a panel of next keys as keycaps with labels, each press narrows the breadcrumb until an action fires with a green toast.

title: Workflow Race Comparison
d: Two lanes race through the same five-step workflow: the automated runner finishes in seconds with a timer under four minutes while the manual runner crawls with amber waits and a timer in hours, then a Time saved figure counts up.

title: Zoom Level Date Picker
d: A date picker that zooms through levels: pressing the title zooms out from days to months to years, each new grid scaling in, and picking a year then a month zooms back down to a day.
